title: Juan Carlos Portantiero
extracted_sentences: Juan Carlos Portantiero (9 August 1934 - 9 March 2007) was an Argentine sociologist .
He specialized in the study of the works of Antonio Gramsci.
With Jose Arico and other intellectuals, he was in charge of the magazine Pasado y Presente, which holds a critical view of Marxism .
He graduated in Sociology in University of Buenos Aires, and went into exile during the last illegal military government (1976-1983) because of threats received.
He moved into Mexico, where he founded the Controversia journal .

After the return of democracy (1983), he became one of the most respected Argentine scholars and had a direct influence on politics as an advisor to Union Civica Radical president Raul Alfonsin and member of the advising team dubbed Grupo Esmeralda .
He served as dean of the University of Buenos Aires Faculty of Social Sciences from 1990 to 1998.
